title: The Crane and the Crab
summary: An old bird by the water struggles for food and seeks help from a small friend.

sentences.text: Once upon a time, a big bird lived near a clear water pool.

The bird stood by the water and looked very sad.
Soon, a little animal came close and asked why the big bird was crying.
The bird told a story about danger coming to the pool.
The animal said that men would soon come to take all the fish away.
The creature, which felt very worried, asked if there was any safe place.
The bird pointed toward a lovely lake far over the hills and offered help.
Day after day, the bird carried fish away in its long mouth.
Instead of helping them, the animal ate every single one.
Soon, it was the turn of the creature to take the trip.
The animal climbed up, and they flew high above the land.
Looking down, the smart creature saw many fish bones on the ground and realized the truth.
Without any fear, the small creature used its strong legs to hold the bird tight.

When they reached the ground again, the quick animal did not let go.

If any new problem ever appeared, they would work together to solve it without fear.
Life by the clear pool became wonderful, and every day brought new joy to the happy animals.
